title: We Stand
text: "We've talked. Not everyone agrees. Enough of us do."

lines.text: "You've been in our heads since the pods. If that thing is in yours, then it's in yours, and we'll fight it there too."
"Practically: the Lantern has to see us to hit us, and it's on Sela. The Gantry can put a strike force on the far side in ten minutes. If we're still here in ten minutes."
"So we're still here in ten minutes."

notes: Partner-led (neither Autonomists nor Devoted lead; Severance already checked): the fight.
